title: Traffic stop — documents not carried
officerCan: Ask you to produce your licence and specified documents.
Note the details and require production within the period allowed by law.
Act under s.207 where the rider holds no licence at all.
officerCannot: Treat 'document not carried' the same as 'no licence exists'.
Detain the vehicle merely because a document was left at home, where the law allows later production.

quotableLine.en: I hold a valid licence. I can produce the documents within the time the law allows. May I show you the digital copy?
quotableLine.hi: मेरे पास वैध लाइसेंस है। कानून जितना समय देता है, उसमें मैं दस्तावेज़ दिखा सकता हूँ। क्या मैं डिजिटल कॉपी दिखा दूँ?
quotableLine.ta: என்னிடம் செல்லுபடியாகும் உரிமம் உள்ளது. சட்டம் அனுமதிக்கும் காலத்திற்குள் ஆவணங்களைக் காட்ட முடியும். இணைய நகலைக் காட்டலாமா?
quotableLine.te: నా వద్ద చెల్లుబాటు అయ్యే లైసెన్స్ ఉంది. చట్టం ఇచ్చిన గడువులోగా పత్రాలు చూపగలను. డిజిటల్ కాపీ చూపవచ్చా?
quotableLine.bn: আমার বৈধ লাইসেন্স আছে। আইনের দেওয়া সময়ের মধ্যে কাগজপত্র দেখাতে পারব। ডিজিটাল কপি দেখাতে পারি?
quotableLine.mr: माझ्याकडे वैध परवाना आहे. कायद्याने दिलेल्या मुदतीत कागदपत्रे दाखवू शकतो. डिजिटल प्रत दाखवू का?
quotableLine.kn: ನನ್ನ ಬಳಿ ಮಾನ್ಯ ಪರವಾನಗಿ ಇದೆ. ಕಾನೂನು ನೀಡಿದ ಅವಧಿಯೊಳಗೆ ದಾಖಲೆ ತೋರಿಸಬಲ್ಲೆ. ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪ್ರತಿ ತೋರಿಸಬಹುದೇ?

doNotSay: Anything that concedes you are unlicensed when you are not.
documentNow: Whether the officer accepted or refused the digital copy, and the reason given.

options.label: Offer the digital copy from DigiLocker or mParivahan.
options.rationale: Digital copies are generally accepted in place of physical documents.

options.label: State clearly that a licence exists and only the physical copy is absent.
options.rationale: This is the distinction that decides whether s.207 detention is even available.

options.label: Ask for the production period the law allows.
options.rationale: Later production is the ordinary route where documents were not carried.
options.tradeoff: You will need to actually produce them.
